inlines.v: UNTA'INTED, adjective 1. Not rendered impure by admixture; not impregnated with foul matter; as untainted air. 2. Not sullied; not stained; unblemished; as untainted virtue or reputation. 3. Not rendered unsavory by putrescence; as untainted meat. 4. Not charged with a crime; not accused; as, he lived untainted
